findings.reason: Exact graphql-scalars 1.22.2 uses bounded /^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$/ in PhoneNumber.parseValue and parseLiteral, not the nested quantifier introduced in 1.24.1. Maintainer advisory description explicitly limits vulnerable code to >=1.24.1 despite broad machine-readable range. Versioned primary source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/graphql-hive/graphql-scalars/v1.22.2/src/scalars/PhoneNumber.ts matches installed implementation (cjs source SHA256 0bea8aed56e3011f66ddb259293072b91e2d1040dc7a6c2ff77b271906a10e19). Independent inspection and real scalar calls reject 40-digit and million-digit failing inputs in under 1ms; no high-severity exception is used.
